```{=html}
<div id="equation-catalog-root"></div>
<script>
fetch("fims_equation_catalog_raw.html")
  .then(r => r.text())
  .then(html => {
    // Pull only cards from prototype html
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
    const grid = doc.querySelector(".grid");
    const root = document.getElementById("equation-catalog-root");
    if (grid) {
      root.innerHTML = "";
      // Rewrap cards in Quarto-friendly container
      const section = document.createElement("section");
      section.className = "fims-equation-grid";
      section.innerHTML = grid.innerHTML;
      root.appendChild(section);
      if (window.MathJax?.typesetPromise) window.MathJax.typesetPromise();
    } else {
      root.innerHTML = "<p>Equation catalog not available.</p>";
    }
  });
</script>
```
